answer: The lagoon test I would run is Proof of unique payment card via tokenized check: a card token that only one bank issued, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a card token that only one bank issued cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the pigment of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the crystal of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
